name: vxr
description: VXR: High-level interactive WebXR and 3D simulation framework for Three.js

scripts.build:vxr: cd VXR && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build:vxr && npm run build:playground
scripts.build:pages: npm run build && mkdir -p examples/dist/projects/cad-viewer examples/dist/projects/cyber-arcade examples/dist/projects/tech-simulator examples/dist/projects/visor-xr examples/dist/projects/virus-purge examples/dist/projects/simulador-pcpuma examples/dist/docs && cp -R "Proyectos/PCPuma Visor arquitectonico/dist/"* examples/dist/projects/cad-viewer/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R "Proyectos/shooter simulator/docs/"* examples/dist/projects/cyber-arcade/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R "Proyectos/pcpum<a simulador/docs/"* examples/dist/projects/tech-simulator/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R "Proyectos/PCPuma Visor arquitectonico/dist/"* examples/dist/projects/visor-xr/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R "Proyectos/shooter simulator/docs/"* examples/dist/projects/virus-purge/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R "Proyectos/pcpum<a simulador/docs/"* examples/dist/projects/simulador-pcpuma/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R docs/* examples/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp examples/dist/index.html ./index.html && touch ./.nojekyll && cp -R examples/dist/assets ./ && cp examples/dist/*.jpg ./ 2>/dev/null || true && cp examples/dist/*.glb ./ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R examples/dist/basic-viewer ./ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R examples/dist/interaction-lab ./ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R examples/dist/architecture-viewer ./ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R examples/dist/scenario-builder ./ 2>/dev/null || true && cp -R examples/dist/projects ./ 2>/dev/null || true

author: VXR Framework
